name: serverest-cypress
description: Automação Cypress do ServeRest com Page Object, contratos da API e relatório Allure.

scripts.test:frontend: npm run allure:clean && cypress run --browser chrome --spec "cypress/e2e/frontend/**/*.cy.ts" && npm run allure:report
scripts.test:frontend:headed: npm run allure:clean && cypress run --headed --browser chrome --spec "cypress/e2e/frontend/**/*.cy.ts" && npm run allure:report
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test: npm run test:e2e && npm run allure:generate
